node.statement: The map satisfying all conclusions is the single iteration output v_R of node 1.3, not the separate existential replacement offered by lem-maincb-error-improvement. Nodes 1.4-1.6 give its unit estimate, recorded defect, extended inclusion, and conditional extended-isomorphism typing. Because node 1.3 constructs v_R with literal type B_R->A_R and amplifications I_n tensor v_R, the source, target corner, and amplification form are unchanged. Together with the universal choices in node 1.1 this establishes every clause of node 1.
